description: Unofficial Bori fan-art companion from Neopets. Original green cel-animation artwork with four simplified overlapping back-armor bands, four broad paws and one curled tuft tail. Bori tidies soft paper, arches a page over its saddle, steps around a blunt foam bar, clears a paper scrap, and moves with three-direction quadruped steps and a low hop. Animation and prop interactions are original adaptations.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
